name: stl-re v1: feature-tree builder with staged deviation loop
summary: Datum + base body, then feature-by-feature: signed deviation -> red-cluster segmentation -> scripted region classifier (extrude/draft/revolve/hole/pattern/...) -> feature added to a JSON feature tree -> generic builder rebuilds -> accept or roll back. Agent (or user, guided mode) only arbitrates ambiguous decision cards. Independent verify stays the final gate.
start_prompt: Turn <scan.stl> into a STEP (calipers in <MEASUREMENTS.md> or scan-only).
milestone: frozen after M3-lite (M1, M2, M2.1, M3-lite); M4 guided mode and the open points moved to the v2 backlog
frozen_note: frozen_commit is recorded in the commit that follows the freeze commit (a commit cannot contain its own hash)
